pluralization.note: Romanian CLDR one/few/other via romanianPluralRule in boot/i18n.ts. few includes 0,2–19,101–119; other includes 20–100,120+. Prefer 4-form for resultsCount: zero|one|few|other with 'de' in other (e.g. {n} de rezultate). validateImport allows +2 forms for ro. Verified in Phase 4E.5 by running real vue-i18n createI18n with the actual romanianPluralRule against Intl.PluralRules('ro') for n=0,1,2,5,12,19,20,21,22,100,101,102,119,120,121,1000,1001,1019,1020 on all 9 plural keys (feed.resultsCount 4-form; posts.daysAgo/hoursAgo/minutesAgo/weeksAgo/monthsAgo/fundsTokens/rewardLabel and profileUi.tokensMeta 3-form): 0 mismatches; 'de' appears exactly for CLDR 'other'.
